propositions: Two size-pressured files (event_append.py at 791/800, _processors.py at 777/800) cannot be fixed by comment triage alone because their comments encode load-bearing replay-compatibility and snapshot-restore migration guards

Multiple verified-stale comments document incorrect module paths (ticket_reducer/llm_format.py -> reducer/llm_format.py), incomplete key enumerations (missing four live maps), false import claims, and outdated schema-bump references that contradict live code

The wire-format changelog exists in two locations with drift: reducer/_version.py:39-66 (complete) and docs/event-schema.md (partial, missing v4/v5), requiring consolidation with docs as the canonical home before code copy is reduced

Comments documenting live runtime invariants (REBAR_HLC kill-switch, SNAPSHOT-restore guards) must be corrected in place rather than deleted to preserve replay compatibility and prevent live guards from appearing dead

The highest-risk do_not_move set (reducer/_processors.py:719-774 snapshot-restore guards) cannot be relocated because their rationale guards against unconditional execution that would clobber recorded channels with unknown values
